name: Fahim Faysal
bio: I’m a Computer Science student at United International University (Class of 2026), passionate about building scalable, user-centric digital solutions. Skilled in full-stack web development (React.js, Redux, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL) and actively expanding my expertise in DevOps and cloud technologies, I build robust, high-impact applications—from real-time platforms to dynamic dashboards. Proficient in Python, JavaScript, C++, and Java, I enjoy writing clean, maintainable code, designing scalable systems, and collaborating effectively using Git/GitHub. Driven by curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, I strive to solve complex problems through efficient, reliable, and meaningful digital solutions.
